sentences.text: Kontraktor lama proyek ini bangkrut, jadi pekerjaan sempat berhenti setahun.
sentences.en: The project's previous contractor went bankrupt, so the work stopped for a year.
sentences.ko: 이 공사의 예전 시공사가 파산해서 일이 일 년 동안 멈췄어요.

sentences.text: Rina pindah ke kantor ini karena perusahaan lamanya bangkrut.
sentences.en: Rina moved to this office because her old company went bankrupt.
sentences.ko: 리나는 전 회사가 파산해서 이 회사로 옮겼어요.

sentences.text: Rudi ditunjuk menjadi juru bicara para tukang saat rapat dengan pemilik proyek.
sentences.en: Rudi was chosen as the workers' spokesman in the meeting with the project owner.
sentences.ko: 루디는 건축주와의 회의에서 인부들의 대변인으로 뽑혔어요.

sentences.text: Di hari pertama, Rina berkenalan dengan juru kamera tim pemasaran.
sentences.en: On her first day, Rina met the marketing team's camera operator.
sentences.ko: 첫날 리나는 마케팅팀 촬영 담당자와 인사했어요.

sentences.text: Menurut Rudi, membangun gedung tinggi itu soal sains, bukan sekadar tenaga.
sentences.en: According to Rudi, building a tall building is about science, not just muscle.
sentences.ko: 루디는 높은 건물을 짓는 건 힘이 아니라 과학이라고 말해요.

sentences.text: Rina lulusan sains komputer dan langsung ditempatkan di tim data.
sentences.en: Rina has a computer science degree and was placed straight in the data team.
sentences.ko: 리나는 컴퓨터 과학을 전공해서 바로 데이터팀에 배치됐어요.

sentences.text: Proyek di sektor perumahan sedang ramai tahun ini.
sentences.en: Projects in the housing sector are booming this year.
sentences.ko: 올해는 주택 부문 공사가 한창이에요.

sentences.text: Perusahaan baru Rina bergerak di sektor energi terbarukan.
sentences.en: Rina's new company works in the renewable energy sector.
sentences.ko: 리나의 새 회사는 재생 에너지 분야에서 일해요.

sentences.text: Rudi belajar keterampilan mengelas dari mandor senior.
sentences.en: Rudi learned welding skills from a senior foreman.
sentences.ko: 루디는 선배 십장에게 용접 기술을 배웠어요.

sentences.text: Manajer bertanya keterampilan apa saja yang Rina kuasai.
sentences.en: The manager asked what skills Rina had.
sentences.ko: 매니저는 리나에게 어떤 기술을 가졌는지 물었어요.

sentences.text: Gedung yang dibangun Rudi nanti akan menjadi rumah sakit swasta.
sentences.en: The building Rudi is working on will become a private hospital.
sentences.ko: 루디가 짓고 있는 건물은 나중에 사립 병원이 될 거예요.

sentences.text: Sebelumnya Rina bekerja di bank swasta selama tiga tahun.
sentences.en: Before this, Rina worked at a private bank for three years.
sentences.ko: 리나는 그전에 민간 은행에서 삼 년 일했어요.

sentences.text: Rudi ingin berbisnis bahan bangunan setelah pensiun dari proyek.
sentences.en: Rudi wants to do business in building materials after retiring from site work.
sentences.ko: 루디는 현장 일을 그만두면 건축 자재 장사를 하고 싶어요.

sentences.text: Rekan baru Rina bercerita bahwa ayahnya berbisnis kopi di Toraja.
sentences.en: Rina's new colleague said her father runs a coffee business in Toraja.
sentences.ko: 리나의 새 동료는 아버지가 토라자에서 커피 사업을 한다고 했어요.

sentences.text: Pemilik proyek menganggap gedung ini sebagai investasi jangka panjang.
sentences.en: The project owner sees this building as a long-term investment.
sentences.ko: 건축주는 이 건물을 장기 투자로 여겨요.

sentences.text: Bagian HR menjelaskan program investasi dana pensiun kepada Rina.
sentences.en: HR explained the pension fund investment programme to Rina.
sentences.ko: 인사팀이 리나에게 연금 투자 제도를 설명했어요.

sentences.text: Kontraktor itu mempekerjakan banyak warga sekitar sebagai tukang.
sentences.en: The contractor hires many local residents as builders.
sentences.ko: 그 시공사는 주변 주민들을 인부로 많이 고용해요.

sentences.text: Perusahaan itu mempekerjakan Rina setelah tiga kali wawancara.
sentences.en: The company hired Rina after three interviews.
sentences.ko: 그 회사는 면접을 세 번 본 뒤 리나를 채용했어요.

sentences.text: Desain gedung itu dibuat oleh biro arsitek dari kota sebelah.
sentences.en: The building was designed by an architecture firm from the neighbouring city.
sentences.ko: 그 건물은 옆 도시 건축 사무소가 설계했어요.

sentences.text: Rina harus mengurus dokumen di biro perjalanan untuk tugas luar kota minggu depan.
sentences.en: Rina has to sort out documents at the travel agency for next week's business trip.
sentences.ko: 리나는 다음 주 출장 때문에 여행사에서 서류를 처리해야 해요.

sentences.text: Anak Rudi baru diterima di akademi teknik sipil.
sentences.en: Rudi's child has just been accepted into a civil engineering academy.
sentences.ko: 루디의 아이가 토목 공학 전문학교에 막 합격했어요.

sentences.text: Atasan Rina dulu juga lulusan akademi statistik yang sama.
sentences.en: Rina's boss also graduated from the same statistics academy.
sentences.ko: 리나의 상사도 같은 통계 전문학교 출신이에요.

sentences.text: Pabrik semen sempat menghentikan produksi, jadi kiriman ke proyek terlambat.
sentences.en: The cement factory halted production for a while, so deliveries to the site were late.
sentences.ko: 시멘트 공장이 한동안 생산을 멈춰서 현장 납품이 늦어졌어요.

sentences.text: Rina diajak melihat ruang produksi panel surya di lantai bawah.
sentences.en: Rina was taken to see the solar panel production room downstairs.
sentences.ko: 리나는 아래층 태양광 패널 생산실을 둘러봤어요.

sentences.text: Rudi sudah sepuluh tahun bekerja bersama partner yang sama di lapangan.
sentences.en: Rudi has worked with the same partner on site for ten years.
sentences.ko: 루디는 현장에서 같은 동료와 십 년째 함께 일해요.

sentences.text: Manajer memperkenalkan Rina kepada partner bisnis dari Singapura.
sentences.en: The manager introduced Rina to a business partner from Singapore.
sentences.ko: 매니저가 싱가포르에서 온 사업 파트너에게 리나를 소개했어요.

sentences.text: Hujan deras menyebabkan kerugian besar karena fondasi harus digali ulang.
sentences.en: The heavy rain caused a big loss because the foundation had to be dug again.
sentences.ko: 폭우로 기초를 다시 파야 해서 손해가 컸어요.

sentences.text: Rina diminta menganalisis penyebab kerugian proyek tahun lalu.
sentences.en: Rina was asked to analyse the causes of last year's project losses.
sentences.ko: 리나는 작년 프로젝트 손실 원인을 분석해 달라는 요청을 받았어요.

sentences.text: Seorang insinyur muda datang memeriksa kekuatan tiang beton.
sentences.en: A young engineer came to check the strength of the concrete pillars.
sentences.ko: 젊은 엔지니어가 콘크리트 기둥의 강도를 점검하러 왔어요.

sentences.text: Meja Rina berada di samping meja seorang insinyur listrik.
sentences.en: Rina's desk is next to an electrical engineer's desk.
sentences.ko: 리나의 자리는 전기 엔지니어 자리 옆이에요.

sentences.text: Rudi mendapat promosi menjadi mandor setelah proyek jembatan selesai.
sentences.en: Rudi was promoted to foreman after the bridge project was finished.
sentences.ko: 루디는 다리 공사가 끝난 뒤 십장으로 승진했어요.

sentences.text: Tim pemasaran sedang menyiapkan promosi besar untuk produk baru.
sentences.en: The marketing team is preparing a big promotion for the new product.
sentences.ko: 마케팅팀은 신제품을 위한 큰 홍보를 준비하고 있어요.

sentences.text: Pemilik proyek itu pengusaha hotel yang jarang datang ke lokasi.
sentences.en: The project owner is a hotel businessman who rarely comes to the site.
sentences.ko: 건축주는 현장에 거의 오지 않는 호텔 사업가예요.

sentences.text: Pendiri perusahaan itu pengusaha muda yang ramah kepada karyawan baru.
sentences.en: The company's founder is a young entrepreneur who is friendly to new staff.
sentences.ko: 그 회사 창업자는 신입 직원에게 친절한 젊은 사업가예요.

sentences.text: Para tukang dijanjikan bonus kalau atap selesai sebelum musim hujan.
sentences.en: The builders were promised a bonus if the roof is finished before the rainy season.
sentences.ko: 인부들은 우기 전에 지붕을 끝내면 보너스를 받기로 했어요.

sentences.text: Rina dengar karyawan di sini dapat bonus akhir tahun yang lumayan.
sentences.en: Rina heard that employees here get a decent year-end bonus.
sentences.ko: 리나는 여기 직원들이 연말 보너스를 꽤 받는다고 들었어요.

sentences.text: Sejak pagi, teknisi listrik memasang kabel di lantai dua.
sentences.en: The electrician has been installing cables on the second floor since morning.
sentences.ko: 전기 기술자가 아침부터 이 층에 전선을 깔고 있어요.

sentences.text: Laptop Rina belum bisa menyala, jadi dia menunggu teknisi IT.
sentences.en: Rina's laptop wouldn't turn on yet, so she waited for the IT technician.
sentences.ko: 리나의 노트북이 켜지지 않아서 리나는 IT 기술자를 기다렸어요.

sentences.text: Beberapa pelajar SMK datang magang di proyek Rudi.
sentences.en: Some vocational school students came to do an internship on Rudi's project.
sentences.ko: 직업고 학생 몇 명이 루디의 현장에 실습하러 왔어요.

sentences.text: Waktu masih pelajar, Rina pernah magang di perusahaan ini.
sentences.en: When she was still a student, Rina once interned at this company.
sentences.ko: 리나는 학생 시절에 이 회사에서 인턴을 한 적이 있어요.

sentences.text: Kontraktor itu bekerjasama dengan pemerintah daerah untuk membangun pasar baru.
sentences.en: The contractor is working together with the local government to build a new market.
sentences.ko: 그 시공사는 지방 정부와 손잡고 새 시장을 짓고 있어요.

sentences.text: Tim Rina bekerjasama dengan universitas untuk riset baterai.
sentences.en: Rina's team works together with a university on battery research.
sentences.ko: 리나의 팀은 대학과 함께 배터리 연구를 해요.

sentences.text: Mandor lebih percaya pada tukang yang berpengalaman untuk memasang rangka atap.
sentences.en: The foreman trusts experienced builders more to put up the roof frame.
sentences.ko: 십장은 지붕 뼈대를 올리는 일은 경험 많은 인부를 더 믿어요.

sentences.text: Rina dibimbing oleh analis berpengalaman selama tiga bulan pertama.
sentences.en: Rina is mentored by an experienced analyst for her first three months.
sentences.ko: 리나는 처음 석 달 동안 경험 많은 분석가에게 지도를 받아요.

sentences.text: Rudi menabung untuk membayar uang kuliah anaknya semester depan.
sentences.en: Rudi is saving to pay his child's tuition for next semester.
sentences.ko: 루디는 아이의 다음 학기 등록금을 내려고 돈을 모으고 있어요.

sentences.text: Adik Rina masih kuliah dan baru masuk semester tiga.
sentences.en: Rina's younger sibling is still at university and has just started the third semester.
sentences.ko: 리나의 동생은 아직 대학생이고 이제 막 삼 학기에 들어갔어요.

sentences.text: Rudi sudah bekerja di dunia konstruksi sejak umur belasan.
sentences.en: Rudi has worked in construction since he was a teenager.
sentences.ko: 루디는 십 대 때부터 건설 일을 해 왔어요.

sentences.text: Kantor Rina berada di gedung yang masih dalam tahap konstruksi di lantai atas.
sentences.en: Rina's office is in a building whose upper floors are still under construction.
sentences.ko: 리나의 사무실 건물은 위층이 아직 공사 중이에요.

sentences.text: Mandor memarahi pekerja yang membuang puntung rokok sembarangan.
sentences.en: The foreman scolded a worker who threw cigarette butts carelessly.
sentences.ko: 십장은 담배꽁초를 아무 데나 버린 인부를 혼냈어요.

sentences.text: Rina diingatkan untuk tidak menyimpan kata sandi sembarangan.
sentences.en: Rina was reminded not to store passwords carelessly.
sentences.ko: 리나는 비밀번호를 아무렇게나 저장하지 말라는 주의를 받았어요.

sentences.text: Rudi tidak bermaksud menyinggung arsitek saat mengkritik desain tangga.
sentences.en: Rudi didn't mean to offend the architect when he criticised the stair design.
sentences.ko: 루디는 계단 설계를 지적할 때 건축가 기분을 상하게 할 생각은 없었어요.

sentences.text: Rina takut menyinggung rekan kerja kalau terlalu banyak bertanya.
sentences.en: Rina is afraid of offending her coworkers if she asks too many questions.
sentences.ko: 리나는 질문을 너무 많이 하면 동료들 기분을 상하게 할까 봐 걱정이에요.

sentences.text: Mandor harus bernegosiasi dengan pemasok soal harga besi.
sentences.en: The foreman had to negotiate with the supplier over the price of steel.
sentences.ko: 십장은 철근 값을 두고 납품업자와 협상해야 했어요.

sentences.text: Rina sempat bernegosiasi soal gaji sebelum menandatangani kontrak.
sentences.en: Rina negotiated her salary before signing the contract.
sentences.ko: 리나는 계약서에 서명하기 전에 연봉 협상을 했어요.

sentences.text: Warga sekitar proyek cukup bersahabat dan sering mengantar kopi.
sentences.en: The residents around the site are quite friendly and often bring coffee.
sentences.ko: 현장 주변 주민들은 꽤 친절해서 커피를 자주 가져다줘요.

sentences.text: Suasana kantor baru Rina ternyata sangat bersahabat.
sentences.en: The atmosphere at Rina's new office turned out to be very friendly.
sentences.ko: 리나의 새 회사 분위기는 알고 보니 아주 화기애애했어요.

sentences.text: Rudi membungkuk untuk mengangkat karung semen dengan hati-hati.
sentences.en: Rudi bent down to lift the cement sack carefully.
sentences.ko: 루디는 시멘트 포대를 조심스럽게 들려고 허리를 굽혔어요.

sentences.text: Rina sedikit membungkuk saat bersalaman dengan direktur.
sentences.en: Rina bowed slightly when she shook hands with the director.
sentences.ko: 리나는 이사와 악수할 때 살짝 고개를 숙였어요.

sentences.text: Di kantor proyek, Rudi mengklik tombol kirim untuk melaporkan kemajuan harian.
sentences.en: At the site office, Rudi clicked the send button to report the daily progress.
sentences.ko: 루디는 현장 사무실에서 전송 버튼을 눌러 그날 진척 상황을 보고했어요.

sentences.text: Rina diminta mengklik tautan untuk mengaktifkan email kantornya.
sentences.en: Rina was asked to click a link to activate her work email.
sentences.ko: 리나는 회사 이메일을 활성화하려고 링크를 눌러 달라는 안내를 받았어요.

sentences.text: Pengawas mempertanyakan kualitas pasir yang dikirim kemarin.
sentences.en: The supervisor questioned the quality of the sand delivered yesterday.
sentences.ko: 감독관은 어제 들어온 모래의 품질을 문제 삼았어요.

sentences.text: Rina mulai mempertanyakan keputusannya pindah kerja saat melihat tumpukan tugas.
sentences.en: Rina began to question her decision to change jobs when she saw the pile of tasks.
sentences.ko: 리나는 쌓인 업무를 보고 이직한 결정을 되묻기 시작했어요.

sentences.text: Pak Darmo adalah tukang tertua di proyek itu, umurnya hampir enam puluh.
sentences.en: Mr Darmo is the oldest builder on the site, almost sixty years old.
sentences.ko: 다르모 씨는 그 현장에서 가장 나이 많은 인부로 거의 예순이에요.

sentences.text: Bu Ani, karyawan tertua di kantor, mengajak Rina makan siang.
sentences.en: Mrs Ani, the oldest employee in the office, invited Rina to lunch.
sentences.ko: 회사에서 가장 오래된 직원인 아니 씨가 리나에게 점심을 같이 먹자고 했어요.

sentences.text: Para pekerja disuruh menjauhi area di bawah derek.
sentences.en: The workers were told to stay away from the area under the crane.
sentences.ko: 인부들은 크레인 아래 구역에 가까이 가지 말라는 지시를 받았어요.

sentences.text: Rina berusaha menjauhi gosip kantor sejak hari pertama.
sentences.en: Rina tries to stay away from office gossip from day one.
sentences.ko: 리나는 첫날부터 사내 뒷말에서 멀리 있으려고 해요.

sentences.text: Rumah-rumah di tepi sungai terancam longsor kalau proyek tidak memasang tembok penahan.
sentences.en: The houses on the riverbank are at risk of a landslide if the project doesn't build a retaining wall.
sentences.ko: 공사 측이 옹벽을 세우지 않으면 강가 집들이 산사태 위험에 놓여요.

sentences.text: Karena pandemi dulu, pekerjaan lama Rina sempat terancam hilang.
sentences.en: Because of the pandemic, Rina's old job was once at risk of disappearing.
sentences.ko: 예전 팬데믹 때 리나의 전 직장은 없어질 위기에 놓였었어요.

sentences.text: Setelah apel pagi, para tukang berpencar ke bagian masing-masing.
sentences.en: After the morning briefing, the builders spread out to their own sections.
sentences.ko: 아침 조회가 끝나자 인부들은 각자 맡은 곳으로 흩어졌어요.

sentences.text: Saat jam makan siang, para karyawan berpencar mencari warung favorit masing-masing.
sentences.en: At lunchtime, the employees scattered to find their favourite food stalls.
sentences.ko: 점심시간이 되자 직원들은 각자 좋아하는 식당을 찾아 흩어졌어요.

sentences.text: Lubang untuk tiang itu harus benar-benar bulat agar pipa bisa masuk.
sentences.en: The hole for the pillar has to be perfectly round so the pipe can fit.
sentences.ko: 파이프가 들어가려면 기둥 구멍이 완전히 둥글어야 해요.

sentences.text: Rapat perkenalan Rina diadakan di meja bulat dekat jendela.
sentences.en: Rina's introduction meeting was held at the round table by the window.
sentences.ko: 리나의 첫인사 회의는 창가의 둥근 탁자에서 열렸어요.

sentences.text: Rudi tidak sengaja menginjak paku dan langsung dibawa ke klinik.
sentences.en: Rudi accidentally stepped on a nail and was taken straight to the clinic.
sentences.ko: 루디는 실수로 못을 밟아서 바로 진료소에 실려 갔어요.

sentences.text: Rina tidak sengaja menginjak kabel dan laptop rekannya hampir jatuh.
sentences.en: Rina accidentally stepped on a cable and her colleague's laptop nearly fell.
sentences.ko: 리나가 실수로 전선을 밟아서 동료의 노트북이 떨어질 뻔했어요.

sentences.text: Atap gedung itu nanti berbentuk kubah besar.
sentences.en: The building's roof will be shaped like a big dome.
sentences.ko: 그 건물 지붕은 큰 돔 모양이 될 거예요.

sentences.text: Kartu akses Rina berbentuk seperti gantungan kunci kecil.
sentences.en: Rina's access card is shaped like a small keyring.
sentences.ko: 리나의 출입 카드는 작은 열쇠고리 모양이에요.

sentences.text: Rudi selalu patuh pada aturan memakai helm di lokasi proyek.
sentences.en: Rudi always obeys the rule of wearing a helmet on site.
sentences.ko: 루디는 현장에서 안전모를 쓰라는 규칙을 늘 지켜요.

sentences.text: Rina berusaha patuh pada aturan kantor meski belum hafal semuanya.
sentences.en: Rina tries to follow the office rules even though she hasn't memorised them all.
sentences.ko: 리나는 아직 다 외우진 못했지만 회사 규칙을 잘 지키려고 해요.

sentences.text: Para tukang menyusun bata merah dengan rapi untuk dinding belakang.
sentences.en: The builders laid red bricks neatly for the back wall.
sentences.ko: 인부들이 뒷벽에 쓸 붉은 벽돌을 가지런히 쌓았어요.

sentences.text: Sore itu Rina menyusun daftar tugas untuk minggu pertamanya.
sentences.en: That afternoon Rina put together a to-do list for her first week.
sentences.ko: 그날 오후 리나는 첫 주에 할 일 목록을 정리했어요.
